scope: exchange-bot PostgreSQL login proposed as obsidian_exchange_bot

postgresObservation.measurement: read-only pg_settings, pg_stat_activity and pg_roles queries

evidence: Python 3.12 default ThreadPoolExecutor on a two-CPU host has six workers
the process exposes seven threads: main plus six executor workers
main_bot.py does not install a larger executor
repository factories create one short-lived psycopg connection per method and repository sources declare no pool
synchronous repository calls on the single event-loop thread serialize with each other

headroomUses: two shutdown recovery or measurement sessions
decision.reason: Seven connections cover the measured one-process execution bound; three additional slots permit bounded diagnosis and recovery.

invariants: ALTER ROLE obsidian_exchange_bot CONNECTION LIMIT 10 is rehearsal-only until separately authorized
no PgBouncer or implicit repository pool is assumed
all repository connections close at method exit
a second process or an explicit executor requires a new budget
ordinary PostgreSQL capacity must remain at least twice the proposed role limit
root OS execution and the shared obsidian_app credential remain blockers, not accepted target state
stopConditions: active bot process count is not exactly one
host CPU count or Python default-executor formula changes
repository method can retain or nest more than one PostgreSQL connection
an explicit executor or connection pool appears
connection denial ambiguous transaction or queue backlog appears during rehearsal
rollback: The bound is proposal-only and not deployed. A later authorized rollout must stop exchange-bot before restoring the prior credential or role limit and reconcile ambiguous money or queue state before restart.
